headline: South Africa Gives ICTSI Three Months to Improve Durban Port Backlog Performance
summary: South African Transport Minister Barbara Creecy stated that container terminal operator ICTSI has been given three months to improve performance at the Durban port or risk losing its operating licence.
why: Port operational efficiency and logistics backlogs directly impact export supply chains, shipping costs, and trade flows across South Africa's economy.

impacts.name: International Container Terminal Services
impacts.why: Threat of losing a major port operating licence increases regulatory and operational risk for the terminal operator.
